name: Favor Amongst the Brotherhood, Fiery Core
label: Quest
description: Favor Amongst the Brotherhood, Fiery Core: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Woe unto those that tempt fate inside the Molten Core. Death comes swiftly - the punishment dealt without mercy.
Many of the Brotherhood have been lost in their search for Fiery Cores.
Offer 1 Fiery Core and you shall be granted favor amongst the Brotherhood.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Your offering has been accepted. Favor you have gained. Continue and you shall be allowed access to the ancient trades.
